_about: What's new: one entry for each update, newest first. The first entry's version is the game's version. A minor entry is hidden until a player asks for every patch. Rules for every string: TONE.md.

items: A new title screen: a battle plays behind the menu while the camera circles it.
What's new: these notes, on the title screen. A New marker shows after an update.
Reading a book shows a large card for the piece it taught, with its glyph, what it does and its numbers, for three seconds or until the next book.
The glossary's spell pieces are the same cards.
Mana costs show with a mana symbol in the laboratory, on cards and in the glossary.
The map table's buttons answer every click while a wall rises.
Every archmage starts knowing Glass Wall and Raise Sub-tower. What you place costs its mana at once and rises a little later, while you do other things.
The map table: E opens the map, Esc closes it, and its panel sits beside the map.
The glossary: press G or the Glossary button at any time to read about every spell piece, your spells, every word and how to do each thing.
Each battle view has its own camera: drag to turn it, right-drag to move it, and turn the mouse wheel to zoom.
An invasion now starts with Invade and summons before any trigger, so every invasion you save sends something.
Buttons and chips are readable in a dark colour scheme.
Online play for up to four, by room code or by pasted codes, with computer rivals in the empty seats.
The first version: Versus against three computer rivals, a practice day, four trials with medals, and achievements.
